hypothesis.statement: Under strict leave-one-subject-out on real wrist accelerometry (HTAD, 3 subjects, 7 home tasks), washing hands (ICF d510) is recognised ABOVE the 1/7 chance level (~0.14) -- recall ~0.53, about 3.7x chance -- and 7-task accuracy is ~0.63. Washing carries a wrist-detectable signature, though on only 3 subjects this is a demonstration, not a definitive validation.

analysis_plan.dataset: HTAD (figshare 6667532), 3 subjects, wrist accelerometer @ ~31 Hz; 7 home tasks (washing/grooming/eating/sweeping/mopping/typing/watch_tv); leave-one-subject-out kNN

decision.threshold: descriptive: washing (d510) leave-one-subject-out recall vs the 1/7 chance level; washing should clear 2x chance (~0.29), demonstrating a wrist-detectable signature
